known.title: Acceptance has no local Claude Code plugin-load check, which `scripts/AGENTS.md` requires for an edit of a plugin
known.locator: Acceptance (body lines 94-104); Engineering standards, step 3 (body line 82); Steps row 3 code_review_rounds (body line 91); scripts/AGENTS.md:140-144
known.summary: Step 3 edits the plan-lifecycle plugin: the `code-reviewer` agent, the plan-manager and yolo skills, and the contract (body line 91). The Edit → release workflow of `scripts/AGENTS.md` (lines 140-144) names a local Claude Code test for such an edit, `claude --plugin-dir ./plugins/<name>` and then `/reload-plugins`. Acceptance (a1 to a7, body lines 94-104) has no row that loads the changed plugin, and Engineering standards for step 3 (body line 82) name no load check, so the plan can pass without showing that the changed agent and skills load. Acceptance must add the plugin-load check with its expected result.
